name: sales-wolf-demo-shop
description: WolfMart - a public demo storefront for showing what QA Wolf catches

scripts.build: npm run install:all && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.heroku-postbuild: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev --include=optional && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install --omit=dev --include=optional
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
